services_heading: Complete Home Repair Services Across Leeds
services_subhead: We handle the odd jobs and emergency fixes that make living in your home easier.

services.title: Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Leaking taps, burst pipes, radiator issues. We diagnose and fix most problems same day, with spares carried on the van.

services.title: Carpentry & Joinery
services.desc: Hung doors, loose floorboards, built-in shelving, and bespoke woodwork. We measure twice and fit it right first time.

services.title: Decorating & Painting
services.desc: Interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and feature walls. Professional finish, minimal disruption to your home.

services.title: Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Faulty sockets, rewiring, light fitting installation, and circuit testing. Part P compliant work you can trust.

services.title: Tiling & Flooring
services.desc: Bathroom and kitchen tile work, vinyl and laminate fitting. We leave your space clean and ready to use.

services.title: Damp & General Repairs
services.desc: Condensation issues, patch repairs, caulking, and maintenance. Quick fixes that stop small problems becoming big ones.

about_pullquote: I started this to be the handyman I wish I'd found when my own roof was leaking.
about_para_1: React Property Repairs was founded on a simple idea: homeowners in Leeds shouldn't have to wait weeks for a reliable tradesman, or worry they're being overcharged for basic fixes. Over 12 years, we've built a reputation for showing up on time, doing the job properly, and leaving your home cleaner than we found it. We're fully insured and Part P registered for electrical work.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we treat every job — whether it's a £50 tap repair or a £5,000 kitchen refit — with the same care and attention. We listen to what you need, give you a straight quote with no hidden costs, and get the work done without fuss. More than half our work now comes from repeat customers and referrals, and that's exactly how we like it.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a bathroom leak that was driving me mad. Rang React on a Tuesday morning, they came out Wednesday afternoon. Found the issue, explained what needed doing, and had it fixed by Friday. Couldn't fault them. Fair price too.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: My kitchen cupboard doors were hanging off and I'd been putting it off for months. They came, sorted it in 90 minutes, and the units look like new. Professional and friendly. Will definitely call them again.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Honest tradesman, which is rare these days. Got a leaking radiator, they diagnosed it quickly, explained the fix without jargon, and charged what they quoted. No extras, no upsell. Already recommended them to two neighbours.
reviews.author: David H.
